description: This PHP class defines the entity 'BuzzLink' for an ORM, representing a link associated with a social media post within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin. It includes properties for id, associated post, link URL, and original link, with corresponding getters and setters.

classes.name: BuzzLink
classes.description: Entity class representing a link related to a Buzz post, mapped to database table 'ohrm_buzz_link' with fields for id, post reference, link URL, and original link.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the BuzzLink object.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the BuzzLink object.

methods.name: setPost
methods.description: Associates a BuzzPost entity with this link.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the URL of the link.

methods.name: setLink
methods.description: Sets the URL of the link.
